WITH last_races AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.circuitId
    FROM races r
    WHERE r.round = (SELECT MAX(r2.round) FROM races r2 WHERE r2.year = r.year)
),
race_avg AS (
    SELECT lr.raceId, c.country, AVG(ds.wins) AS race_wins
    FROM last_races lr
    JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = lr.circuitId
    JOIN driverStandings ds ON ds.raceId = lr.raceId
    GROUP BY lr.raceId, c.country
),
country_avg AS (
    SELECT country, AVG(race_wins) AS avg_wins
    FROM race_avg
    GROUP BY country
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg FROM country_avg
),
above AS (
    SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins
    FROM country_avg ca, overall o
    WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.overall_avg
),
grp AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS group_avg FROM above
)
SELECT a.country,
       a.avg_wins,
       a.avg_wins - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg,
       a.avg_wins - g.group_avg AS above_group_avg
FROM above a, overall o, grp g
WHERE a.avg_wins > g.group_avg
ORDER BY a.avg_wins DESC;
